dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans with service-connected disabilities pursuing rehabilitation programs and educational counseling.
dimensions.evidence: a rehabilitation program for a veteran under this chapter that includes the pursuit of a course of flight training

dimensions.assessment: Changes provide administrative improvements, expanded program approvals for flight training, and mandated response timelines for program extensions.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall approve or deny a request for an extension under paragraph (1) not later than 30 days after the date on which the veteran submits such request.

dimensions.assessment: The source does not specify major federal funding increases, though it extends pension payment limits and establishes administrative call center requirements.
Amends title 38 of the United States Code regarding Department of Veterans Affairs counseling, training programs, and pension limits.
dimensions.evidence: Section 3697B(a) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking the second sentence.

dimensions.assessment: Provisions are permanent statutory amendments, with reporting requirements lasting for five years and pension limit extensions running through July 2033.

missing_information: Exact fiscal cost estimates for the new call center and expanded vocational training programs
Number of veterans expected to utilize non-degree flight training
importance_detail.rationale: The bill affects veterans seeking vocational rehabilitation and education services by removing counselor location restrictions, allowing specific flight training, creating a dedicated helpline, setting a 30-day timeline for extension decisions, and extending a pension limit.
